shim: score_oracle.py installs a minimal gevent.lock.RLock substitute because Scoring reaches it transitively through cmsranking.Store; the real service needs the full gevent stack
corrects: The hand-derived expectation for /history in the first draft of seed.json was wrong: it listed the u1/t0 change to 0.0 at 1700003000. Score.append_change only appends to the history when the computed score differs from the current one, so a change that leaves the score at 0.0 produces no history entry.

score_modes.max_subtask: element-wise max over each submission's extra list, summed
score_modes.max_tokened_last: max of the released scores and the last submission's score
